# Historical Operation encoding — superseded

These unchanged JSON inputs retain the original compiler regression baseline. They encode a pure snapshot decision as Operation, which conflicts with the active Operation criterion. They must not be used as current modeling guidance or as evidence that read-only classifications are Operations.

The owner-approved current example is [capacity classification](../../../examples/capacity-classification/README.md): Calculation with a typed conditional Enum result and explicit references to the same strict Rule and snapshot. The Operation criterion and the relationship catalog remain unchanged. Historical receipts are evidence of the earlier encoding only.
